block_condition.condition: if the admitted stream cannot support a causal OFI state at 1 s without lookahead, the named defect is reported instead of substituting a proxy
block_condition.finding: not triggered: the state consumes only messages stamped at or before the decision instant, and the independent strictly-past rebuild of level 1 from direct level-1 increments reproduces the admitted grid midpoint at 59,999 / 59,999 quoted instants exactly (M2/src/es_materiality.py audit)

c_star_rule: C* = g - C0 (M2/src/envelope.py::break_even_residual); it is the largest unresolved cost per round trip at which the measured gross displacement vanishes, and it is reported in bps of the entry midpoint and in USD per contract

classification_contract.coverage_failure: INDETERMINATE_COVERAGE with the failing metric named
classification_contract.kill: KILL_MATERIALITY when g <= 0 OR the uncertainty upper bound hi <= C0
classification_contract.sample_scope_rule: an admitted single 10-minute window can produce at most a SAMPLE-SCOPED DEVELOPMENT KILL; a nominal SURVIVE_PROVISIONAL is downgraded to INDETERMINATE_COVERAGE with the scope clause naming the single window and is never reported as survival
classification_contract.significance: statistical significance is never an input to the classification
classification_contract.survive: SURVIVE_PROVISIONAL when the lower bound lo > C0

clock.consume_rule: a decision at instant t consumes exactly the messages whose exchange_send_ns <= t; a message stamped after t is never consumed, and the exit state consumes exactly the quotes whose exchange_send_ns <= t + horizon
clock.robustness_reason: capture receipt is the strictest availability clock available on this slice; the admitted slice satisfies transact_time <= exchange_send <= ts_recv for every row. The conservative pass is reported in full and is never the reported verdict.

cost_items.name: CME exchange transaction fee, ES non-member/incentive default class
cost_items.notes: the linked fee schedule could not be extracted in this environment and the exchange's own technical pages returned 403 / page-not-found (.research/resolution/BRANCH_A/REPORT.md S3, S5); the one third-party per-side figure that was found (USD 1.28) is recorded as REJECTED in M1/work/patches/P-0003.json because it came from a non-primary article. No amount is therefore admissible.

cost_items.name: CME clearing fee for the selected customer class, if separately itemized
cost_items.notes: same unreachable schedule; no clearing amount is verified for any participant status.

cost_items.name: FCM commission, routing and platform pass-through
cost_items.notes: account-specific and not owned by this project; the exact account-level schedule is the pre-shadow gate UNK-0009-ECON-CME-MEASURED, not a precursor input.

coverage_floor.observation_coverage_definition: evaluated slots (quote at entry and exit AND a non-zero state) over all primary decision slots
coverage_floor.quote_coverage_definition: decision slots in the primary horizon whose entry instant carries a two-sided strictly positive uncrossed quote, over all primary decision slots
coverage_floor.rule: a floor failure is reported as INDETERMINATE_COVERAGE with the failing metric named; it never silently re-scopes the measurement, and the nominal figures are still reported

data.instrument: ESU3 (CME SecurityID 3445, read from admission.json at run time)
data.window: 2023-07-17T13:30:00Z-2023-07-17T13:40:00Z, read from admission.json at run time

decision_question: On the single admitted CME ESU3 10-minute RTH-open slice (2023-07-17 13:30:00Z-13:40:00Z), does a causal signed order-flow-imbalance state have side-signed midpoint displacement at the frozen H3 horizons that can clear the measured observed-spread structural cost C0, or is it small enough at the primary horizon that no execution model could change the decision?
external_dependency: the admitted artefacts above were produced by W2 (epoch 1) and independently re-derived byte-identically by V2 (verification wave 2); trades.csv and bbo_increments.csv hashes above equal V2's independent re-derivations

friction.basis: 1/2 S_entry + 1/2 S_exit from the OBSERVED quoted spread prevailing at the entry instant and at the exit instant, expressed in bps of the entry midpoint, evaluated by M2/src/envelope.py::midpoint_markout_friction_bps
forbidden: any arbitrary multiple of C0 as a safety factor
friction.identity_note: E[1/2 S_entry + 1/2 S_exit] = E[S] is an identity, not evidence; the friction is taken per observation at both instants rather than from a single pooled mean

horizons.censoring: a decision slot at second k is evaluated only when k + horizon <= 599, i.e. the exit instant lies inside the admitted 10 ms grid
horizons.out_of_contract: sub-100 ms delays are explicitly out of contract for this branch
horizons.primary_reason: 1 s is the earliest H3 point and the one whose forward window contains the least later, irrelevant flow
horizons.primary_rule: the verdict is computed at the primary horizon only; the 5 s and 15 s points are the reported term structure and can never be substituted for it after the fact

mechanism: Causal signed order-flow imbalance built from aggressor-signed trades relative to the contemporaneous displayed executable liquidity, computed only from messages available at the decision instant.
outcome: side-signed midpoint markout in bps of the entry midpoint, on the reconstructed top of book: direction * (M(t + horizon) - M(t)) / M(t) * 1e4. No executable-price substitution anywhere in the outcome.
own_manifest: M2/experiments/M2-BRIDGE-ES-H3-OFI/run_inputs.json (written after the run; it never alters this freeze)
permitted_post_result_decisions: reporting additional summary statistics of the already-evaluated observation set
fixing a defect that prevents the frozen measurement from running, without changing any frozen parameter
proposing a canonical update for the controller to apply
prohibited_post_result_decisions: bootstrap block length, seed or resample count
any second outcome pass on this window

scope.rule: a nominal SURVIVE_PROVISIONAL is downgraded to INDETERMINATE_COVERAGE with the SINGLE_ADMITTED_WINDOW_SCOPE clause; a KILL stands and is recorded as a SAMPLE_SCOPED_DEVELOPMENT_KILL with its boundary (round trip in bps, the window, the contract, the horizon)
scope.statement: One admitted CME ESU3 window (2023-07-17 13:30:00Z-13:40:00Z), one venue, one instrument, one session, one contract month. This measurement can support at most a sample-scoped development kill; it cannot support survival, breadth or regime claims.

state.definition: x(t) = (V_buy - V_sell) / D(t), where V_* is the aggressor-signed ESU3 trade size stamped in the half-open interval (t - 1 s, t] and D(t) = bid_sz + ask_sz displayed at the decision instant
state.direction_rule: x > 0 is LONG, x < 0 is SHORT; aggressor_side 1 = buy aggressor, 2 = sell aggressor
state.lookback_basis: one decision interval, the shortest accumulation window consistent with the 1 s primary horizon; fixed here and never searched
state.thresholds: none: the sign of the state is the direction, so no threshold exists to tune
state.zero_policy: x == 0, no trades in the lookback, or a missing / zero-depth / crossed quote is NO position and is excluded from the evaluated set while still being counted in coverage; it is never a zero-valued observation

statistics.cluster_count_limit: with one admitted instrument the instrument-level cluster is the window itself, so the 60 s block is the finest declared dependence unit that leaves more than one cluster; the resulting interval is development-grade and is reported with its cluster count
statistics.dependence_unit: one instrument x one contiguous 60-decision-slot (60 s) block; overlapping forward returns inside a block share a price path
statistics.interval: percentile 2.5 / 97.5 of the cluster-resample distribution of the mean, via M2/src/calculate.py::block_bootstrap_ci
statistics.seed_rule: seed + horizon_seconds * seed_stride + state_index, state_index 0 for the pooled horizon figure, 1 for LONG, 2 for SHORT
statistics.significance: reported separately through envelope.significance_against_zero and never an input to the classification

unresolved_c1_scenarios_basis: a DISPLAY lattice of 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2 and 4 times the verified one-tick contract value (ESU3 tick 0.25 index points x ContractMultiplier 50 = USD 12.50, from the instrument's own secdef via M2/data/derived_es/2023-07-17T133000Z/admission.json). It is contract economics, NOT a fee estimate: no level is a verified charge, no probability is assigned to any level, and C1's true value stays UNKNOWN (never zero). The reporter's break-even residual C* is the admissible unresolved cost, and it is comparable to this lattice only as a magnitude.
